regions.text:
“Oh! no! It’s not a Hen. It’s a Squirrel.”
“Come on, Squirrel, follow me. Let’s find the Hen. Where is she?”
“May be Hen is behind this basket. Can you see a furry tail?”
“Oh! no! It’s not Hen. It’s Cat.”
“Come on, Cat, follow me. Let’s find the Hen. Where is she?”
“Who’s behind this rose garden? Can you see a stripy nose?”
“Come on, Fox follow me. I’ll lead you to our picnic spot.”
“Still no Hen! Where did she go?”
"Calf can't guess. Can you guess?"
39
